description: Run a preflight check on the active document with a preflight profile and list the problems found (optionally saving a report)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of problems to list

profile.description: Preflight profile name, e.g. "[Basic]" (the built-in profile). Embedded document profiles are checked first, then application profiles.

reportPath.description: Optional absolute path to save the preflight report (.pdf or .txt)

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for preflight to finish

name: preflight_document
title: Preflight Document
